# Clinamenic LLC / SSC Studio

> Professional services and writing on organizational design, governance, branding, and digital knowledge systems. Public site at https://www.ssc.studio

This file is a curated map for agents and documentation tools. It does not affect search rankings. Prefer these pages over thin notes or tag indexes.

## Site

- [Home](https://www.ssc.studio/): Consultancy overview
- [About](https://www.ssc.studio/about): Media, presentations, and background
- [Services](https://www.ssc.studio/services): Service offerings
- [Writing portfolio](https://www.ssc.studio/writing): Essay index
- [Zettelgarten hub](https://www.ssc.studio/zettelgarten): Knowledge garden entry (individual zettel notes are noindex by default)

## Machine indexes

- [Sitemap](https://www.ssc.studio/sitemap.xml): Crawlable URL list

## Citations

UUID permalinks of the form `https://www.ssc.studio/{uuid}` redirect to the canonical slug page and are stable citation targets. Prefer the canonical slug URL when sharing content with readers.
